name: vect-or-edit
description: VectOrEdit ,Next-Generation Vector-based Semantic Knowledge Editor & Real-Time Linter
author: 1abcdefggs (https://github.com/1abcdefggs)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); try{cp.execSync('taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){} try{cp.execSync('taskkill /F /IM VectOrEdit.exe /T',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){} ['dist','out','release','bin-release','build-dist','installer-release'].forEach(d => { try{fs.rmSync(d, {recursive:true, force:true});}catch(e){} }); const appData=process.env.APPDATA ? require('path').join(process.env.APPDATA,'vect-or-edit') : ''; if(appData && fs.existsSync(appData)){ try{fs.rmSync(appData, {recursive:true, force:true});}catch(e){} }"
scripts.predev: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); try{cp.execSync('taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){} try{cp.execSync('taskkill /F /IM VectOrEdit.exe /T',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){}"
scripts.dev:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); try{cp.execSync('taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){} const appData=process.env.APPDATA ? require('path').join(process.env.APPDATA,'vect-or-edit') : ''; if(appData && fs.existsSync(appData)){fs.rmSync(appData, {recursive:true, force:true}); console.log('VectOrEdit development app data reset.');}"
